skill.description: Bootstrap open-source projects with documentation, CI/CD, and polish. Use when user asks to "set up docs", "add MkDocs", "create GitHub Actions", "add funding", "polish README", "add Giscus comments", "bootstrap project", or wants to improve project presentation and infrastructure.
skill.body:
# Project Bootstrap Bootstrap open-source projects with professional documentation, CI/CD, and polish. ## Components | Component | What it does | |-----------|--------------| | **MkDocs** | Material theme docs with tabs, code copy, dark mode | | **GitHub Actions** | Auto-deploy docs on push to main | | **Giscus** | GitHub Discussions-based comments on docs | | **README** | Polished README with badges, tables, examples | | **Funding** | Ko-fi badge, GitHub Sponsors | ## Quick Reference ### MkDocs Setup Create `mkdocs.yml`: ```yaml site_name: Project Name site_url: https://ninyawee.github.io/REPO repo_url: https://github.com/ninyawee/REPO theme: name: material custom_dir: docs/overrides palette: - scheme: default primary: indigo toggle: icon: material/brightness-7 name: Switch to dark mode - scheme: slate primary: indigo toggle: icon: material/brightness-4 name: Switch to light mode features: - content.code.copy - navigation.sections - navigation.expand markdown_extensions: - pymdownx.highlight: anchor_linenums: true - pymdownx.superfences - pymdownx.tabbed: alternate_style: true - tables - admonition - pymdownx.details nav: - Home: index.md - Getting Started: getting-started.md ``` Add mise task: ```toml [tasks."docs:serve"] run = "uv run --with mkdocs-material mkdocs serve" [tasks."docs:build"] run = "uv run --with mkdocs-material mkdocs build" ``` ### GitHub Actions - Docs Deploy Create `.github/workflows/docs.yml`: ```yaml name: Deploy Docs on: push: branches: [main] paths: ['docs/**', 'mkdocs.yml', '.github/workflows/docs.yml'] workflow_dispatch: permissions: contents: write jobs: deploy: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 - uses: actions/setup-python@v5 with: python-version: '3.12' - run: pip install mkdocs mkdocs-material - run: mkdocs gh-deploy --force ``` ### Giscus Comments **Prerequisites** (Giscus requires public repo with Discussions enabled): ```bash # Enable discussions gh repo edit ninyawee/REPO --enable-discussions # Verify repo is public and discussions enabled gh repo view ninyawee/REPO --json visibility,hasDiscussionsEnabled ``` **Setup steps:** 1. Run the commands above to enable discussions 2. Go to https://giscus.app and enter repo name 3. Copy `data-repo-id` and `data-category-id` Create `docs/overrides/main.html`: ```html {% extends "base.html" %} {% block content %} {{ super() }}

{{ lang.t("meta.comments") }}

{% endblock %} ``` ### README Polish #### Docs Link (add after description) ```markdown 📖 **[Documentation](https://ninyawee.github.io/REPO/)** ``` #### Badges ```markdown [![PyPI](https://img.shields.io/pypi/v/PACKAGE)](https://pypi.org/project/PACKAGE/) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/PACKAGE)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/PACKAGE) [![crates.io](https://img.shields.io/crates/v/PACKAGE)](https://crates.io/crates/PACKAGE) [![Documentation](https://img.shields.io/badge/docs-ninyawee.github.io%2FREPO-blue)](https://ninyawee.github.io/REPO) [![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/ninyawee/REPO)](LICENSE) ``` **[Documentation](https://ninyawee.github.io/REPO/)**` 5. **Packages table** (if multi-package) 6. **Quick example** code block 7. **Installation** section 8. **Usage** examples 9. **Support/Funding** [![Ko-fi](https://img.shields.io/badge/Ko--fi-Support%20me%20☕-ff5f5f?logo=ko-fi&logoColor=white)](https://ko-fi.com/ninyawee) ``` #### GitHub Sponsors Create `.github/FUNDING.yml`: ```yaml ko_fi: ninyawee github: ninyawee ``` ### Package Metadata Add docs/repo URLs to package manifests: #### Cargo.toml (Rust) ```toml [package] name = "package-name" version = "0.1.0" edition = "2021" license = generated_query: I just created a new open-source Rust crate called `tombox` for encrypted file storage. The repo is at `github.com/myname/tombox`. I need to set up professional documentation with a clean theme (preferably dark/light toggle, code copy), auto-deploy it to GitHub Pages whenever I push to main, and add a comment section at the bottom of each docs page using GitHub Discussions. Also, I want to polish the README: add a nice tagline, badges (for crates.io, license, and docs link), a quick example, installation instructions, usage, and a funding section with a Ko-fi button and GitHub Sponsors link. Finally, update the `Cargo.toml` to include the repository, homepage, and documentation URLs. Can you help me do all of that?

### GitHub Actions - Docs Deploy

Create `.github/workflows/docs.yml`:

```yaml
name: Deploy Docs

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths: ['docs/**', 'mkdocs.yml', '.github/workflows/docs.yml']
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - run: pip install mkdocs mkdocs-material
      - run: mkdocs gh-deploy --force
```

# Project Bootstrap

Bootstrap open-source projects with professional documentation, CI/CD, and polish.

## Components

| Component | What it does |
|-----------|--------------|
| **Sphinx** | Read the Docs theme docs with custom CSS |
| **GitHub Actions** | Publish docs on push to main |
| **Utterances** | GitHub Issues-based comments on docs |
| **README** | Polished README with badges, tables, examples |
| **Funding** | Ko-fi badge, GitHub Sponsors |

## Quick Reference

### Sphinx Setup

Create `conf.py`:

```python
import sphinx_rtd_theme

extensions = [
    'sphinx_rtd_theme',
    'sphinx.ext.autodoc',
    'sphinx.ext.napoleon',
]
html_theme = 'sphinx_rtd_theme'
html_theme_path = [sphinx_rtd_theme.get_html_theme_path()]
html_theme_options = {
    'style_nav_header_background': '#2980b9',
}
```

Add `docs/requirements.txt`:

```
sphinx
sphinx-rtd-theme
```

Add mise task:

```toml
[tasks."docs:serve"]
run = "uv run --with sphinx sphinx-autobuild docs docs/_build/html"

[tasks."docs:build"]
run = "uv run --with sphinx sphinx-build -b html docs docs/_build/html"
```

### GitHub Actions - Docs Deploy

Create `.github/workflows/docs.yml`:

```yaml
name: Deploy Docs

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - run: pip install -r docs/requirements.txt
      - run: sphinx-build -b html docs docs/_build/html
      - uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v3
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          publish_dir: docs/_build/html
```

### Utterances Comments

**Prerequisites** (Utterances requires public repo with Issues enabled):

```bash
# Verify repo is public
gh repo view ninyawee/REPO --json visibility

# Issues are enabled by default, ensure they are not disabled
gh repo edit ninyawee/REPO --enable-issues
```

**Setup steps:**

1. Run the command to ensure issues are enabled.
2. Create `docs/_templates/layout.html`:

```html
{% extends "!layout.html" %}

{% block footer %}
  <script
    src="https://utteranc.es/client.js"
    repo="ninyawee/REPO"
    issue-term="pathname"
    theme="github-light"
    crossorigin="anonymous"
    async
  ></script>
{% endblock %}
```

Add to `conf.py`:

```python
templates_path = ['_templates']
```

### README Polish

#### Docs Link (add after description)

```markdown
📖 **[Documentation](https://ninyawee.github.io/REPO/)**
```

#### Badges

```markdown
[![crates.io](https://img.shields.io/crates/v/PACKAGE)](https://crates.io/crates/PACKAGE)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/ninyawee/REPO)](LICENSE)
[![docs](https://readthedocs.org/projects/REPO/badge/?version=latest)](https://ninyawee.github.io/REPO)
```

#### Structure Pattern

1. **Title** with tagline
2. **Badges** row
3. **One-liner** description
4. **Docs link**
5. **Quick example** code block
6. **Installation** section
7. **Usage** examples
8. **Support/Funding** section
9. **License**

### Funding

#### Ko-fi Badge

```markdown
[![Ko-fi](https://img.shields.io/badge/Ko--fi-Support%20me%20☕-ff5f5f?logo=ko-fi&logoColor=white)](https://ko-fi.com/ninyawee)
```

#### GitHub Sponsors

Add `.github/FUNDING.yml`:

```yaml
github: ninyawee
```

### Package Metadata

Add docs/repo URLs to Cargo.toml:

```toml
[package]
name = "tombox"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
license = "MIT"
description = "Encrypted file storage in Rust"
repository = "https://github.com/myname/tombox"
homepage = "https://myname.github.io/tombox"
keywords = ["encryption", "storage"]
categories = ["filesystem"]
```

## Checklist

When bootstrapping a project:

- [ ] Create `docs/` structure (index.rst, conf.py)
- [ ] Create `docs/_templates/layout.html` for Utterances
- [ ] Create `.github/workflows/docs.yml`
- [ ] Add `docs:serve` and `docs:build` tasks to mise.toml
- [ ] Add docs link to README
- [ ] Add badges to README
- [ ] Polish README structure
- [ ] Add `.github/FUNDING.yml`
- [ ] Ensure Issues are enabled for Utterances
- [ ] Update Cargo.toml with repo/homepage URLs

# Project Bootstrap

Bootstrap open-source projects with professional documentation, CI/CD, and polish.

## Components

| Component | What it does |
|-----------|--------------|
| **MkDocs** | Material theme docs with tabs, code copy, dark mode |
| **GitHub Actions** | Auto-deploy docs on push to main |
| **Giscus** | GitHub Discussions-based comments on docs |
| **README** | Polished README with badges, tables, examples |
| **Funding** | Ko-fi badge, GitHub Sponsors |

## Quick Reference

### MkDocs Setup

Create `mkdocs.yml` with Material theme configuration including dark/light toggle and code copy. Refer to MkDocs Material documentation for the exact YAML.

Add mise task:

```toml
[tasks."docs:serve"]
run = "uv run --with mkdocs-material mkdocs serve"

[tasks."docs:build"]
run = "uv run --with mkdocs-material mkdocs build"
```

### GitHub Actions - Docs Deploy

Set up a GitHub Actions workflow that runs `mkdocs gh-deploy` on push to main.

### Giscus Comments

**Prerequisites** (Giscus requires public repo with Discussions enabled):

```bash
# Enable discussions
gh repo edit ninyawee/REPO --enable-discussions

# Verify repo is public and discussions enabled
gh repo view ninyawee/REPO --json visibility,hasDiscussionsEnabled
```

**Setup steps:**

1. Run the commands above to enable discussions
2. Go to https://giscus.app and enter repo name
3. Copy `data-repo-id` and `data-category-id`

To add comments, create a `docs/overrides/main.html` file that overrides the content block and includes the Giscus script with the appropriate repo and category IDs.

### README Polish

#### Docs Link (add after description)

```markdown
📖 **[Documentation](https://ninyawee.github.io/REPO/)**
```

#### Badges

```markdown
[![PyPI](https://img.shields.io/pypi/v/PACKAGE)](https://pypi.org/project/PACKAGE/)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/PACKAGE)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/PACKAGE)
[![crates.io](https://img.shields.io/crates/v/PACKAGE)](https://crates.io/crates/PACKAGE)
[![Documentation](https://img.shields.io/badge/docs-ninyawee.github.io%2FREPO-blue)](https://ninyawee.github.io/REPO)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/ninyawee/REPO)](LICENSE)
```

#### Structure Pattern

1. **Title** with Thai meaning if applicable
2. **Badges** row (optional)
3. **One-liner** tagline (Thai + English for Thai projects)
4. **Docs link** `📖 **[Documentation](https://ninyawee.github.io/REPO/)**`
5. **Packages table** (if multi-package)
6. **Quick example** code block
7. **Installation** section
8. **Usage** examples
9. **Support/Funding** section
10. **License**

See `references/readme-template.md` for full example.

### Funding

#### Ko-fi Badge

```markdown
[![Ko-fi](https://img.shields.io/badge/Ko--fi-Support%20me%20☕-ff5f5f?logo=ko-fi&logoColor=white)](https://ko-fi.com/ninyawee)
```

#### GitHub Sponsors

Create `.github/FUNDING.yml`:

```yaml
ko_fi: ninyawee
github: ninyawee
```

### Package Metadata

Add docs/repo URLs to package manifests:

#### Cargo.toml (Rust)

```toml
[package]
name = "package-name"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
license = "MIT"
description = "Short description"
repository = "https://github.com/ninyawee/REPO"
homepage = "https://ninyawee.github.io/REPO"
documentation = "https://ninyawee.github.io/REPO"
keywords = ["keyword1", "keyword2"]
categories = ["category"]
```

#### pyproject.toml (Python)

```toml
[project]
name = "package-name"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Short description"
license = "MIT"
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.9"
keywords = ["keyword1", "keyword2"]
authors = [{ name = "Nutchanon Ninyawee", email = "me@nutchanon.org" }]

[project.urls]
Homepage = "https://github.com/ninyawee/REPO"
Documentation = "https://ninyawee.github.io/REPO"
Repository = "https://github.com/ninyawee/REPO"
```

#### package.json (Node.js)

```json
{
  "name": "package-name",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "Short description",
  "license": "MIT",
  "author": "Nutchanon Ninyawee <me@nutchanon.org>",
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "https://github.com/ninyawee/REPO"
  },
  "homepage": "https://ninyawee.github.io/REPO",
  "bugs": "https://github.com/ninyawee/REPO/issues",
  "keywords": ["keyword1", "keyword2"]
}
```

## Checklist

When bootstrapping a project:

- [ ] Create `mkdocs.yml` with Material theme
- [ ] Create `docs/` structure (index.md, getting-started.md, api/)
- [ ] Create `docs/overrides/main.html` for Giscus
- [ ] Create `.github/workflows/docs.yml`
- [ ] Add `docs:serve` and `docs:build` tasks to mise.toml
- [ ] Add docs link to README (`📖 **[Documentation](https://ninyawee.github.io/REPO/)**`)
- [ ] Add badges to README
- [ ] Polish README structure
- [ ] Add `.github/FUNDING.yml`
- [ ] Enable GitHub Discussions for Giscus
- [ ] Update package metadata (Cargo.toml/pyproject.toml/package.json) with docs URLs

Create `.github/workflows/docs.yml`:

```yaml

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths: ['docs/**', 'mkdocs.yml', '.github/workflows/docs.yml']
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - run: pip install mkdocs mkdocs-material
      - run: mkdocs gh-deploy --force
```

# Project Bootstrap Bootstrap open-source projects with professional documentation, CI/CD, and polish. ## Components | Component | What it does | |-----------|--------------| | **MkDocs** | Material theme docs with tabs, code copy, dark mode | | **GitHub Actions** | Auto-deploy docs on push to main | | **Giscus** | GitHub Discussions-based comments on docs | | **README** | Polished README with badges, tables, examples | | **Funding** | Ko-fi badge, GitHub Sponsors | ## Quick Reference ### MkDocs Setup Create `mkdocs.yml`: ```yaml site_name: Project Name site_url: https://ninyawee.github.io/REPO repo_url: https://github.com/ninyawee/REPO theme: name: material custom_dir: docs/overrides palette: - scheme: default primary: indigo features: - navigation.sections - navigation.expand markdown_extensions: - pymdownx.highlight: anchor_linenums: true - pymdownx.superfences - pymdownx.tabbed: alternate_style: true - tables - admonition - pymdownx.details nav: - Home: index.md - Getting Started: getting-started.md ``` Add mise task: ```toml [tasks."docs:serve"] run = "uv run --with mkdocs-material mkdocs serve" [tasks."docs:build"] run = "uv run --with mkdocs-material mkdocs build" ``` ### GitHub Actions - Docs Deploy Create `.github/workflows/docs.yml`: ```yaml name: Deploy Docs on: push: branches: [main] paths: ['docs/**', 'mkdocs.yml', '.github/workflows/docs.yml'] workflow_dispatch: permissions: contents: write jobs: deploy: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 - uses: actions/setup-python@v5 with: python-version: '3.12' - run: pip install mkdocs mkdocs-material - run: mkdocs gh-deploy --force ``` ### Giscus Comments **Prerequisites** (Giscus requires public repo with Discussions enabled): ```bash # Enable discussions gh repo edit ninyawee/REPO --enable-discussions # Verify repo is public and discussions enabled gh repo view ninyawee/REPO --json visibility,hasDiscussionsEnabled ``` **Setup steps:** 1. Run the commands above to enable discussions 2. Go to https://giscus.app and enter repo name 3. Copy `data-repo-id` and `data-category-id` Create `docs/overrides/main.html`: ```html {% extends "base.html" %} {% block content %} {{ super() }}

{{ lang.t("meta.comments") }}

{% endblock %} ``` ### README Polish #### Docs Link (add after description) ```markdown 📖 **[Documentation](https://ninyawee.github.io/REPO/)** ``` #### Badges ```markdown [![PyPI](https://img.shields.io/pypi/v/PACKAGE)](https://pypi.org/project/PACKAGE/) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/PACKAGE)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/PACKAGE) [![crates.io](https://img.shields.io/crates/v/PACKAGE)](https://crates.io/crates/PACKAGE) [![Documentation](https://img.shields.io/badge/docs-ninyawee.github.io%2FREPO-blue)](https://ninyawee.github.io/REPO) [![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/ninyawee/REPO)](LICENSE) ``` #### Structure Pattern 1. **Title** with Thai meaning if applicable 2. **Badges** row (optional) 3. **One-liner** tagline (Thai + English for Thai projects) 4. **Docs link** `📖 **[Documentation](https://ninyawee.github.io/REPO/)**` 5. **Packages table** (if multi-package) 6. **Quick example** code block 7. **Installation** section 8. **Usage** examples 9. **Support/Funding** section 10. **License** See `references/readme-template.md` for full example. ### Funding #### Ko-fi Badge ```markdown [![Ko-fi](https://img.shields.io/badge/Ko--fi-Support%20me%20☕-ff5f5f?logo=ko-fi&logoColor=white)](https://ko-fi.com/ninyawee) ``` #### GitHub Sponsors Create `.github/FUNDING.yml`: ```yaml ko_fi: ninyawee github: ninyawee ``` ### Package Metadata Add docs/repo URLs to package manifests: #### Cargo.toml (Rust) ```toml [package] name = "package-name" version = "0.1.0" edition = "2021" license = "MIT" description = "Short description" repository = "https://github.com/ninyawee/REPO" homepage = "https://ninyawee.github.io/REPO" documentation = "https://ninyawee.github.io/REPO" keywords = ["keyword1", "keyword2"] categories = ["category"] ``` #### pyproject.toml (Python) ```toml [project] name = "package-name" version = "0.1.0" description = "Short description" license = "MIT" readme = "README.md" requires-python = ">=3.9" keywords = ["keyword1", "keyword2"] authors = [{ name = "Nutchanon Ninyawee", email = "me@nutchanon.org" }] [project.urls] Homepage = "https://github.com/ninyawee/REPO" Documentation = "https://ninyawee.github.io/REPO" Repository = "https://github.com/ninyawee/REPO" ``` #### package.json (Node.js) ```json { "name": "package-name", "version": "0.1.0", "description": "Short description", "license": "MIT", "author": "Nutchanon Ninyawee ", "repository": { "type": "git", "url": "https://github.com/ninyawee/REPO" }, "homepage": "https://ninyawee.github.io/REPO", "bugs": "https://github.com/ninyawee/REPO/issues", "keywords": ["keyword1", "keyword2"] } ``` ## Checklist When bootstrapping a project: - [ ] Create `mkdocs.yml` with Material theme - [ ] Create `docs/` structure (index.md, getting-started.md, api/) - [ ] Create `docs/overrides/main.html` for Giscus - [ ] Create `.github/workflows/docs.yml` - [ ] Add `docs:serve` and `docs:build` tasks to mise.toml - [ ] Add docs link to README (`📖 **[Documentation](https://ninyawee.github.io/REPO/)**`) - [ ] Add badges to README - [ ] Polish README structure - [
